enumeration: GitHub REST issues/pulls open,100 per page until short page; PR files/comments/reviews paginated. Checks requested100 and all five recorded. This dated snapshot excludes the future self-documentation PR.

issues.title: [P3] Cmd+Q on macOS likely bypasses the unsaved-work close guard
[P3] Small follow-ups from the September reviews
Review follow-ups after #28 (tracking)
[bugsweep] Take analysis invents timing and dynamics scores (silence scores 100/100, no take can score below 65/70 %)
[bugsweep] Exported band MIDI misses cue hits and note-offs at loop wraps / stop / ending (hanging notes in REAPER)
[bugsweep] Follow-energy re-clones the pattern every 256-frame block and can switch intensity tiers mid-bar
[bugsweep] Engine robustness follow-ups: SMF VLQ panic, unbounded tempo/meter in export, hung device open joins forever, silent DI-channel fallback, one-sided humanise jitter, tuner gate at -26 dBFS
[bugsweep] Charts and styles drop unknown JSON fields on rewrite and no registry checks schemaVersion (invariant 6)
[bugsweep] Media generation cannot be cancelled: a hung provider blocks all media work and the close guard for up to 10 minutes
[bugsweep] Takes deleted outside the app stay listed until manually removed; insert_take failures are handled inconsistently; SQLite has no busy_timeout
[bugsweep] Installed agents: cancelling an npm .cmd shim kills cmd.exe but leaves node.exe running; executable path is only checked for absolute + extension
[bugsweep] The controls/ seam is a phantom: black-spirit-200.json has no bindings, ControlMapManifest has no consumer, and the seams test validates a file nothing reads
main has no branch protection or ruleset: CI is not a merge gate, force-push and direct push are allowed
CI hardening: Dependabot, scheduled advisory scan, SHA-pinned actions, concurrency cancellation, job timeouts, MSRV job, --locked, pnpm cache
Release process: the only tag (v0.1.0) points at the "100% BUILD COMPLETE" stub commit and never produced a release; release.yml attaches no checksums and does not depend on CI
Repo hygiene: issue/PR templates, P1 + area labels, milestones matching the status board, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY.md, CODEOWNERS, changelog
docs: ARCHITECTURE.md describes a repository layout, IPC contract, provider traits, data model, capabilities and logging that do not match the tree; split "as built" from "target design"
docs: status board marks M0, M1b and M1d complete with unmet acceptance criteria; ARCHITECTURE section 9.1-9.3 lists tolerance tests that do not exist
docs: stale paths, commands and recipes in AGENTS.md, plan, DESIGN.md, EXTENDING.md, ADR 0006 and the spike files
[bugsweep] Offline Jo parser answers "Got it!" to anything, re-runs after provider failures and can execute transport commands the user did not ask for; style ids are hard-coded outside the registry
[bugsweep] UI robustness follow-ups: solo helper misreads CM/sus2, Film undo per keystroke, optimistic state not rolled back, numeric nits, circular save-conflict message, raw ZodError blobs
docs: manual and DESIGN.md promises that the UI does not keep (Save video vs Save project, Escape-from-help, 48 kHz claim, Songs formats, design tokens)
feat: real instrument sounds - asset pipeline (manifest, SHA-256 download, assets_ensure) plus a CC0 multisampled drum kit and SoundFont bass/keys
feat: automatic latency calibration by loopback, with the engine reporting its own lookahead (M1e)
feat: Jo by voice - push-to-talk, STT, TTS, voice bus with ducking, 30-utterance fixture (M2)
feat: real songs - stem separation, beats/chords/key analysis, minus-guitar mix and time-stretch/transpose (M3)
feat: Lyria RealTime steerable stream on the ai bus, plus generated tracks landing analysed in the library (M4)
feat: rig scheduler with 50 ms lookahead on the timeline, MIDI clock, panic, dry-run and CC learn mode (M5 remainder)
feat: LLM take review from evidence, progress trends over the last 20 takes, SMF round-trip test (M6 remainder)
feat: onboarding wizard (devices, latency, keys with "test key", rig ports, assets), diagnostics log export, and code signing / notarisation (M7 remainder)
feat: extensibility proofs - six synthetic seam fixtures, a changed-files scope check, a Rust IPC_VERSION mirror and a TS/Rust contract round-trip test (DoD 9, invariant 12)
decision: invariant 2 "48 kHz internally, always" is not implemented - the engine follows the device rate; implement edge resampling or supersede the invariant by ADR
feat: guitarist-facing engine features that fall out of existing seams - loop-pass takes, bar-quantised capture keep, chord markers in the tempo map, loop tempo trainer, section count-in

improvement: app-layer housekeeping - native file picker for imports, open_url/reveal-in-folder, single instance, usage-log rotation, media_delete, settings range validation and schemaVersion gate, cost:state from media/agent calls
improvement: UI affordances a guitarist will miss - Undo/Redo shortcuts, persistent tempo and bar:beat readout, recording counter, Jo echoes applied state, take notes/rename, error boundary
[bugsweep] Replacing a reference still plays the previous song from the output ring
[bugsweep] Offline Jo swallows loop-the-verse while a reference is loaded
[bugsweep] Offline Jo load song keeps punctuation and and-play so the title misses
[bugsweep] Stop on a section-looped practice ramp counts bars before the loop
[bugsweep] Playing reference telemetry publishes prepared speed, not the speed in the output queue
[bugsweep] Band tempo while a reference is loaded claims there is no beat grid
[bugsweep] Bracket transpose unloads a reference and starts the chart
